creative_angle: Elevating sensitive-skin care from clinical anxiety to a grounding, restorative daily ritual.
consumer_insight: Consumers with reactive skin do not want aggressive interventions; they seek gentle, trustworthy stabilization that respects their skin barrier without artificial additives.
creative_message: Botanical recovery rooted in mineral stillness and clinical purity.
communication_objective: Make sensitive-skin buyers perceive the serum as an authoritative, soothing dermatological anchor, ruling out chaotic clinical clutter and hippie-natural clichés.
creative_route: Chose architectural botanical still-life over application portraiture to assert timeless formulation stability and restorative peace.
brand_personality: Quietly authoritative botanical apothecary; speaks with scientific restraint and tactile warmth rather than loud efficacy hype.
attention_sequence: First the tactile mineral-stone bottle anchor, second the fresh Centella botanical cue, third the calming barrier recovery promise.
asset_reasoning: As a square poster viewed at a glance, the visual must instantly communicate tranquil stability and botanical refinement without cognitive friction. It functions as a calming visual refuge that earns closer engagement with the barrier-restoration message.

visual_translation.scene_moment: An amber-frosted serum bottle rests solidly atop a chiseled, porous travertine slab under warm Mediterranean morning light. A live Centella asiatica sprig curves beside it, casting a soft, rhythmic shadow across the pale mineral surface.
visual_translation.human_presence: No human subject is present; the deliberate solitude emphasizes pure formulation integrity and uninterrupted skin barrier restoration.
visual_translation.typography_intent: Spoken in an understated, editorial cadence with ample breathing room, presenting clinical efficacy as an established truth rather than an urgent sales pitch.
visual_translation.camera_intent: Straight-on eye level with a slight upward tilt, granting the bottle sculptural permanence and immediate physical trustworthiness.
visual_translation.subject_representation: The serum bottle anchored on unpolished stone with fresh Centella leaves, visually equating ancient botanical resilience with modern dermatological care.
visual_translation.atmosphere: Quiet, sun-drenched Mediterranean dawn with meditative clarity.
visual_translation.lighting_character: Low, raking morning sunlight that brings out the tactile roughness of travertine and creates warm amber glass refractions.
visual_translation.material_treatment: Tactile, porous stone, matte amber-frosted glass, and crisp, dew-touched green foliage.
visual_translation.composition_principle: Centered architectural equilibrium anchoring the lower-middle frame with breathable negative space above.
visual_translation.colour_direction: Sun-bleached ecru, warm sand, muted leaf green, and rich amber undertones.

commercial_goal: Establish immediate prestige dermatological authority and drive purchase intent for sensitive-skin barrier repair.
target_customer_psychology: Discerning shoppers exhausted by irritating active ingredients, looking for natural ingredients backed by serious formulation discipline.
composition_strategy: A stable central product anchor on raw travertine stone, balanced by organic foliage shadows and generous open space for authorized brand copy.
prompt_guidance: An amber-frosted glass serum bottle resting on a chiseled travertine stone block in warm morning Mediterranean sunlight, accented by delicate green Centella asiatica leaves and soft shadows.
compression_notes: Focused strictly on travertine texture, glass amber transparency, and botanical Centella accents in a square frame.
